the state ALPR statute coverage table is seeded from evidence-sourced
state statutes, not the stale carry-forward · **I8 §4.4 / ACQ-06**
(origin-verified statute-seed refresh) · **I7-C9 [B-39] = `a`**
(the recorded operator decision: "refresh the statute seed from
origins") · **SIG-INGEST-050** (the per-state duty rows + the gated
`future_statutory_disclosure_*` sources) · **I7 NEW-7** (NCSL/LAPPA/
GHSA/MultiState are enumeration aids, never cited) · cited context,
owned elsewhere: **SIG-CONF-014** (declared lineage — the origin URL +
verified_on + packet evidence ids ride every claim) ·
**SIG-INGEST-046c** (a statute row whose rights posture carries a
reservation is refused by P36.1a's mechanism — this row seeds under it)
· the §26 acquisition rules · **SIG-INGEST-049f** (the seed contract:

public state code — not a §6 compact-table or §22.4–22.5/§35.1
ecosystem project — so SIG-CHART-033 / SIG-INGEST-029 / SIG-INGEST-030a

`docs/tickets/270_P35.10__state-alpr-statute-seed-2026.md` (manifest
row 270, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B) · **Base:**

mutations:** none — committed seed data + unpermitted registry rows
only; the refreshed seed first affects production on the Wave-A roll
(P35.11).

## Why

The only state-ALPR statute inventory in the spine was the frozen 2022
NCSL-derived seed (`as_of 2022-02-03`): 16 states, stale — it omits
Virginia §2.2-5517 (eff. 2025-07-01) and the whole 2025–2026 enactment
wave the I7 packets verified at origin. I7-C9's recorded answer `a`
says refresh *from origins*: every entry must cite its own
legislature/governor page and verification day; the inventory aids that
enumerated the statutes are never cited themselves.

## What ships

- **The v2 asset** — `state_alpr_statute_seed_2026.toml`
  (`schema = "statute_seed/2"`, `supersedes_asset` naming the frozen
  2022 asset; both stay committed and loadable — append-only, P7):
  - **8 `[[statutes]]` entries**, each origin-cited from the committed
    I7 packets (live-read 2026-09-30): WA ESSB 6002 (ch. 239),
    NM SB 40 (Driver Privacy and Safety Act, ch. 20), OR SB 1516,
    KY HB 58 (Acts ch. 71), CT PA 26-14, MO **EO 26-18** (typed
    `executive_order`, never `statute`), ID S1180 / Idaho Code §49-1432,
    VA §2.2-5517 — each carrying `origin_url`, `instrument_type`,
    `effective_date` + honest `date_basis` (effective | signed | issued
    | reported), `verified_on`, `confidence`, and the packet
    `evidence` ids.
  - **50 `[[duty_rows]]`** — the per-state coverage/duty table
    (SIG-INGEST-050): 8 `origin_verified` (this asset), 16 `recorded`
    (the superseded asset named as `statute_ref` — honest provenance),
    26 `none_recorded` (**absence of evidence**, never a "no statute"
    claim — §3.1; each carries the enumeration-sweep evidence ids).
    Six rows name registered `future_statutory_disclosure_*` duties
    with commencement dates and notes: VA §2.2-5517 I/J/K report cycle,
    NM DPS April-1 agency reports (first 2027-04-01), AL 265-X-6
    registry/audit/report, AR 12-CAR-150-103(f) public statistics,
    UT 77-23e-106(3)(a) FR reports, MN HF 3198 (contingent — enactment
    unverified, recorded as a lead only).
- **The strict v2 parser** (`statute_seed.py`, connector `1.1.0`):
  `schema` dispatch keeps the v1 shape byte-for-byte; v2 rows must
  carry non-empty `origin_url` (a legislature/governor host — an
  enumeration-aid host is `ContentDrift`), ISO `effective_date` /
  `verified_on`, reviewed `instrument_type` / `date_basis` /
  `confidence` vocabulary, non-empty evidence ids; `supersedes_asset`
  must name the committed 2022 asset; `state_count` / `duty_row_count`
  re-derive; duty-row states are unique and the `origin_verified` set
  must equal the `[[statutes]]` set. Extract/normalize stamp per-entry
  provenance (`source_url` = the origin, `retrieved_date` =
  `verified_on`, packet `evidence_ids`) on every instrument claim —
  `executive_order` typing flows end-to-end; `us.state` stays a
  candidate (SIG-INGEST-034); the `as_of` label stays first-class.
- **Registry wiring** — `seeds.toml`: the `state_alpr_statute_inventory_2026`
  row (committed-asset URN target — a compiled multi-origin asset has
  no single upstream URL). `sources.toml`: the new seed source +
  six gated `future_statutory_disclosure_*` duty rows, all
  `ingestion_permitted=false`, rights left UNREVIEWED (no reviewer
  signature is claimed). `live_dispositions.toml`: one `mirror` row per
  new duty source (the seed source is connector-mapped).
  `runner.py`: `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` routes the new seed source to
  `state_statute_seed`.

## Validation

- `make check` — green: ruff, format, mypy (339 files), pytest (Docker
  daemon absent → `tests/db` / `tests/e2e` honestly skipped per their
  skip banners; `SIG_GCP_PROJECT` sentinel armed for P34.2's fail-closed
  leak scan), `verify-gen` clean.
- `uv run pytest tests/connectors` — **1,163 passed / 1 skipped**
  (the credential-env scan's honest skip) under the armed sentinel.
- `uv run pytest tests/connectors/test_statute_seed.py` — 37/37.
- `uv run sig-connectors validate` — exit 0: **594 registered**
  (587 + the seed row + 6 duty rows), 236 permitted **unchanged** —
  no `ingestion_permitted` flips.
- `make docs-check` — green; `memory_guard all --staged` green;
  `git diff --check` clean.
- `run_seed` end-to-end: 49 claims, 8 instruments (7 `statute` +
  1 `executive_order`), per-entry origin evidence + packet ids, the
  `as_of` label claim; registry row stays unpermitted and a live run
  still refuses.

#### Test plan

- v2 asset parses: `schema`/`supersedes_asset`/8 entries/50 duty rows;
  every entry has a non-empty `origin_url` (legislature/governor host),
  parseable `effective_date` + `verified_on`, reviewed vocabulary,
  non-empty evidence ids.
- 50-state coverage: duty-row states == the canonical 50; the
  `origin_verified` set == the entry set; `recorded` rows name the
  superseded asset; `none_recorded` rows assert no instrument.
- Executive-order typing: Missouri is `executive_order` through
  `run_seed`, the other 7 `statute`.
- No enumeration-aid citation: ncsl.org / legislativeanalysis.org /
  ghsa.org / multistate.us origins are `ContentDrift`; no emitted claim
  cites them.
- Drift set: unknown keys, missing origin/verified_on, bad dates,
  wrong `instrument_type`/`date_basis`/`confidence`/`supersedes_asset`,
  count mismatches, duplicate duty states, posture/entry mismatch,
  `none_recorded` carrying an instrument — all refuse.
- Load path: `run_seed` emits typed claims with per-entry origin
  provenance and the `as_of` claim; a second load asserts identical
  content digests; the 2022 asset still loads (append-only).
- Registry wiring: seed row unpermitted + live-refused; the six duty
  sources are registered, unpermitted, exactly one `mirror`
  disposition each; the VA I/J/K and NM 2027-04-01 duties are named.

## Explicitly NOT done (committed-data boundary)

No fetch, no deploy, no live stage or leg, no `ingestion_permitted`
flip, no HG-03 answer, no scheduler enablement, no claim-spine write,
no production mutation, no CI-config change. Wave-A activation is
P35.11's roll; statute-check connector behaviour beyond the seed input
is out of scope per the ticket; the 16 `recorded` states were not
re-verified at origin — they keep the 2022 asset as their honest
provenance until a later row does that work.
